title: Per-Matrix Optimality Is Not Enough: Three-Level Optimization for Low-Rank LLM Compression
abstract: arXiv:2609.15838v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Per-matrix singular value decomposition (SVD) truncation is Eckart-Young optimal in the whitened Frobenius norm, but errors from independently compressed matrices compound through the block's nonlinear forward pass. Inspired in part by hierarchical variational optimization in quantum many-body methods, we introduce a three-level chain that widens optimization scope from individual matrices to Transformer blocks to the full model: whitened SVD~(L1), block-level joint optimization~(L2), and end-to-end language-modeling loss refinement~(L3), all from 256 calibration sequences, with no instruction or recovery data. On LLaMA-7B at 60% compression, the chain reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 42.1 to 19.1 to 11.4. The block-level stage acts as a regularizer: skipping it worsens Penn Treebank (PTB) perplexity by 24 points, a gap that additional end-to-end training did not close in our experiments. translated_title: 单矩阵最优性是不够的：面向低秩大语言模型压缩的三级优化方法
translated_abstract: 单矩阵奇异值分解（SVD）截断在白化Frobenius范数下是Eckart-Young最优的，但独立压缩各矩阵所产生的误差会通过块的非线性前向传播而复合累积。部分受量子多体方法中分层变分优化的启发，我们引入了一个三级优化链条，将优化范围从单个矩阵扩展到Transformer块，再到整个模型：白化SVD（L1）、块级联合优化（L2）以及端到端语言建模损失精炼（L3），全部过程仅使用256条校准序列，无需任何指令数据或恢复数据。在LLaMA-7B上以60%压缩率进行压缩时，该链条将WikiText-2困惑度从42.1降至19.1，再降至11.4。块级优化阶段起到了正则化器的作用：跳过该阶段会使Penn Treebank（PTB）困惑度恶化24个点，且在我们的实验中，额外的端到端训练也无法弥补这一差距。困惑度收益在20-80%的压缩率范围内均保持稳定。
tldr: 该论文提出一种受量子多体分层变分优化启发的三级优化链（白化SVD、块级联合优化、端到端精炼），仅需256条校准序列即可将LLaMA-7B在60%压缩率下的WikiText-2困惑度从42.1降至11.4，并证明块级优化作为正则化器不可或缺。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a quantum many-body-inspired three-level optimization chain (whitened SVD, block-level joint optimization, and end-to-end refinement) that reduces LLaMA-7B's WikiText-2 perplexity from 42.1 to 11.4 at 60% compression using only 256 calibration sequences, while showing the block-level stage acts as an indispensable regularizer.
